rows.name: culture_items
rows.value: @calc(Object.values([].concat(Object.values(@data.semis_culture || {}).filter(x => String(x.upa_code || '') === String(@fields.upa_code) && String(x.semis_id || '').trim() === String(@local.selected_semis_id || '').trim()), Object.values(@data.post_semis_culture || {}).filter(x => String(x.upa_code || '') === String(@fields.upa_code) && String(x.post_semis_id || '').trim() === String(@local.selected_post_semis_id || '').trim()), Object.values(@data.recolte_culture || {}).filter(x => String(x.upa_code || '') === String(@fields.upa_code) && String(x.recolte_id || '').trim() === String(@local.selected_recolte_id || '').trim())).reduce((acc, x) => { const key = String(x.culture_id || '').toLowerCase().trim(); if (key && !acc[key]) acc[key] = { culture_id: key }; return acc; }, {})))

rows.name: cout_semis_totals
rows.value: @calc(Object.values(@data.semis_culture || {}).filter(x => String(x.upa_code || '') === String(@fields.upa_code) && String(x.semis_id || '').trim() === String(@local.selected_semis_id || '').trim()).reduce((acc, x) => { const n = v => Number(String(v || 0).replace(',', '.')) || 0; const key = String(x.culture_id || '').toLowerCase().trim(); const detail = n(x.cout_transport) + n(x.cout_chaux_agricole) + n(x.cout_pnt_png) + n(x.cout_superficie_labouree) + n(x.cout_semence_achetee) + n(x.cout_herbicide_prelevee); if (key) acc[key] = (acc[key] || 0) + (n(x.cout) || detail); return acc; }, {}))

rows.name: cout_post_semis_totals
rows.value: @calc(Object.values(@data.post_semis_culture || {}).filter(x => String(x.upa_code || '') === String(@fields.upa_code) && String(x.post_semis_id || '').trim() === String(@local.selected_post_semis_id || '').trim()).reduce((acc, x) => { const n = v => Number(String(v || 0).replace(',', '.')) || 0; const key = String(x.culture_id || '').toLowerCase().trim(); const detail = n(x.cout_sarclage) + n(x.cout_desherbage) + n(x.cout_npk) + n(x.cout_uree) + n(x.cout_herbicide) + n(x.cout_buttage) + n(x.cout_insecticide); if (key) acc[key] = (acc[key] || 0) + (n(x.cout) || detail); return acc; }, {}))

rows.name: cout_recolte_totals
rows.value: @calc(Object.values(@data.recolte_culture || {}).filter(x => String(x.upa_code || '') === String(@fields.upa_code) && String(x.recolte_id || '').trim() === String(@local.selected_recolte_id || '').trim()).reduce((acc, x) => { const n = v => Number(String(v || 0).replace(',', '.')) || 0; const key = String(x.culture_id || '').toLowerCase().trim(); const detail = n(x.cout_total_prestation_recolte) + n(x.cout_total_battage); if (key) acc[key] = (acc[key] || 0) + (n(x.cout) || detail); return acc; }, {}))

rows.name: cout_totals
rows.value: @calc([@local.cout_semis_totals || {}, @local.cout_post_semis_totals || {}, @local.cout_recolte_totals || {}].reduce((acc, obj) => { Object.keys(obj || {}).forEach(key => acc[key] = (acc[key] || 0) + Number(obj[key] || 0)); return acc; }, {}))
